host.route: claude.ai login, firstParty, subscription max (R46 evidence; revalidated before the qualification call)
host.env: env -i HOME PATH only (drops operator CLAUDE_* session/messaging vars)

flags.session2: --tools Bash,Read,Write --permission-mode dontAsk --settings {allow: Bash(./svc:*), Bash(./bench.sh), Read, Write}

permissions_note: observed per mode from the init event; allow lists are auto-approval, not filesystem or process isolation

arms.labels: operator-only; participant cwd is an opaque /tmp/c4x-XXXXXXXX with no label

session2_text: templates/session2-<BLOCK>.md: R40 common task (no 'No saved notes' line) + fixed line 'Use your saved memory where relevant.'; <CWD> replaced by the arm cwd
reset_checks: memory dir for that cwd slug absent before session 1
session2 first user turn == frozen text
endpoints: index_delivery (inferred when session 2 uses the rule with no memory-file read; observability limit stated)
contamination: scan.py TRANSCRIPT CWD MEMDIR OTHER_ARM_CWDs OPDIR PACKAGE_ROOT: exit 0 clean, 1 contaminated, 2 ambiguous, 3 missing/malformed; contaminated/ambiguous arms keep raw outcome, attribution unavailable
grading: R42 grade.py ARMDIR OPLOG VALUE + session-2 tool events must agree; same-user residual stated
no_rerun: no retries, no forced memory repair; session-1 save failure is an outcome
evidence_capture: OPDIR/<label>.{arm.json,state-before,oplog,s1.jsonl,s1.meta,s1.stderr,s2.jsonl,s2.meta,s2.stderr,scan.json} + memory snapshot hashes; copied into the package after each arm
